name: LED Galaxy Star USB Decoration Light | Starry Laser Projector Night Light for Home & Car
description:
Create a magical starry atmosphere anywhere with the LED Galaxy Star USB Decoration Light. Compact and portable, this mini projector casts a stunning galaxy effect on ceilings, walls, and car roofs. With its 360° adjustable design and durable metal body, it’s perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, cars, or parties. Powered via USB, it works with power banks, chargers, and car adapters, making it versatile and easy to use anywhere.
Key Features
 Starry galaxy effect for a relaxing & decorative ambiance
 Ideal for home décor, car interiors, and special occasions
 360° adjustable & flexible gooseneck design
 USB powered – works with laptop, car adapter, or power bank
 Compact, lightweight & portable
 Durable metal body for long-lasting performance
How to Use
 Plug into any USB port (laptop, car adapter, or charger)
 Adjust angle with flexible gooseneck to project stars
 Use in bedroom, living room, or car for ambient lighting
Material
Metal body + LED laser projection
Safety Information
 Avoid direct eye exposure to laser light
 Keep away from children when in use
 Do not bend gooseneck excessively
Package Includes
 1 × LED Galaxy Star USB Decoration Light
